_readme: weeks: one theme per week, keyed by the week's SUNDAY (YYYY-MM-DD); shown as 'This week: <theme>' and in the share text. days: one entry per date (YYYY-MM-DD). side: internal note on which side of the week's theme the day covers (not shown). verses: 1 OT then 2 NT, KJV word for word. quiz: one question per verse ('verse' is the verse index, 'answer' is the index of the right choice). commentary: null, or {text, father, work, source_url} from a Church Father before AD 451, verified in a public-domain source; shown under the verses only when filled in. See README.md.
